Follow-up data about treatment episodes were available up until 2013. Cox regression analyses were used to assess whether duration of treatment and relapse into mental health care were related.", 'The majority of patients did not return into mental health care (86\xa0%). Question: Is duration of psychological treatment for depression related to return into treatment?

Options: 
A. yes
B. no
C. maybe

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
